_source: CRM Operations → Excess Utility export (sample shape; real data lands via /com/operations/property-operations-data/{id}/utilities/ once staff API token is wired).
_methodology: Per Notion meeting 12 May 2026: each booking has a utility cap. cap_mode=per_room means unit allowance = sum of per-room caps; cap_mode=per_unit means unit allowance = highest cap among bookings. Excess = max(0, actual_bill − unit_allowance), split evenly across all tenants in the unit.
